en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide street lined with late‑19th‑century buildings. On the right is a large, ornate institutional building with tall windows and pilasters; beside it stands a corner tenement with balconies and decorative facades. Leafless trees line the street, a few horse‑drawn carriages are visible in the distance, and a person stands near a wooden fence in the foreground. There is handwritten text across the sky area, and printed caption text at the top left.
